summary.en: Eight small lessons for people who have never programmed: what compiling and running mean, variables, if and for, methods, arrays, strings, your first class, and how to read error messages. After them, the first chapter of the Java course makes sense.
summary.zh: 给从没写过程序的人准备的八节小课：编译和运行是什么，变量，if 和 for，方法，数组，字符串，第一个类，以及怎样读懂报错信息。学完以后，再读 Java 课程的第一章就能跟上。

needs.en: A computer where you may install software: Windows 10 or 11, macOS or Linux. You only need it for the Set up section. Every example also runs on this page with nothing installed.
needs.zh: 一台允许你安装软件的电脑：Windows 10 或 11、macOS 或 Linux。只有“准备你的电脑”这一节才用得到它。每个例子也能直接在本页运行，什么都不用安装。

needs.en: No programming experience. You do need to create and save a plain text file, and to type exactly what is shown. Java treats capital and small letters as different, and one missing bracket can stop everything.
needs.zh: 不需要任何编程经验。你需要会新建并保存纯文本文件，并且照着示例一个字符一个字符地敲。Java 区分大小写，少一个括号就可能整个程序都不能用。

needs.en: About 30 minutes for the first setup, then 15 to 25 minutes per lesson. Type every example yourself instead of only reading it.
needs.zh: 第一次准备环境大约 30 分钟，之后每节课 15 到 25 分钟。每个例子都自己敲一遍，不要只看。

needs.en: A recent browser for the Run button (Chrome or Edge 119, Firefox 120, Safari 18.2, or newer), and pen and paper. Writing small programs by hand is a good way to learn them.
needs.zh: 一个较新的浏览器来使用“运行”按钮（Chrome 或 Edge 119、Firefox 120、Safari 18.2，或更新的版本），再准备纸和笔。手写小程序是学会它们的好办法。

intro.en:
A JDK (Java Development Kit) is the free toolbox that builds and runs Java programs on your own computer. It holds two programs you will use all the time: javac, the compiler, and java, the program that runs your code.

You can skip this section for now. Press Run under any example on this page and it runs in your browser. Be clear about what that is: the Run button uses a reduced copy of Java's standard library. It is enough for these lessons, but some programs behave differently there, and some do not run at all. A real JDK is still worth installing, and your course expects you to use one.

We use Eclipse Temurin from Adoptium, a free and widely used build of the open-source OpenJDK. Choose the latest LTS version. LTS means long-term support: that version keeps getting updates for years. In November 2026 the latest LTS is Java 25. Java 21 and Java 17 are also LTS and work for everything in this guide. Check adoptium.net for the current number.

Two words you will meet below. A terminal is a window where you type commands as text. It is called Command Prompt or PowerShell on Windows, and Terminal on macOS. PATH is the list of folders the terminal searches when you type a command name. If the folder that holds java and javac is not on that list, the terminal says it cannot find them.

If your computer is set to another language, Java may print its messages in that language. To get English messages, put -J-Duser.language=en after javac, as in: javac -J-Duser.language=en Main.java
intro.zh:
JDK（Java Development Kit，Java 开发工具包）是一套免费的工具，用来在你自己的电脑上编译并运行 Java 程序。里面有两个你会天天用到的程序：javac 是编译器，java 负责运行你的代码。

这一节现在可以先跳过。点开本页任意一个例子下面的“运行”，代码就在浏览器里运行。但要分清楚：运行按钮用的是精简过的 Java 标准库，够这些课使用，不过有些程序在那里的表现不一样，有些根本跑不起来。所以还是值得装一个真正的 JDK，你的课程也会要求你用真正的 JDK。

我们用 Adoptium 提供的 Eclipse Temurin，它是开源 OpenJDK 的一个免费、广泛使用的版本。请选择最新的 LTS 版本。LTS 是长期支持版：这个版本会连续多年得到更新。2026 年 11 月最新的 LTS 是 Java 25；Java 21 和 Java 17 也是 LTS，本指南里的所有内容都能用。当前的版本号请到 adoptium.net 上确认。

下面会遇到两个词。终端是你用文字输入命令的窗口，Windows 上叫“命令提示符”（Command Prompt）或 PowerShell，macOS 上叫“终端”（Terminal）。PATH 是一份文件夹清单：你在终端里输入一个命令名时，系统会到清单里的文件夹去找这个命令。如果存放 java 和 javac 的文件夹不在清单里，终端就会说找不到它们。

如果你的电脑设置的是别的语言，Java 可能用那种语言显示报错信息。想看英文报错，在 javac 后面加上 -J-Duser.language=en，例如：javac -J-Duser.language=en Main.java

steps.en: The page lets you pick the version, the package type, the operating system and the architecture. Pick the version marked LTS (25 at the time of writing), the type JDK, the operating system Windows and the architecture x64. Download the file that ends in .msi. Most Windows PCs are x64. If yours has an Arm processor (Settings, System, About, System type), use the Linux steps inside WSL instead.
steps.zh: 这个页面让你选择版本、包类型、操作系统和架构。选标有 LTS 的版本（写作时是 25），类型选 JDK，操作系统选 Windows，架构选 x64。下载以 .msi 结尾的文件。大多数 Windows 电脑是 x64。如果你的电脑用的是 Arm 处理器（在“设置”“系统”“关于”的“系统类型”里查看），请改在 WSL 里按 Linux 的步骤来做。

steps.en: Double-click the .msi file. Accept the license. On the Custom Setup screen, check that Add to PATH is switched on. It is on by default. Setting JAVA_HOME is optional and not needed for this guide.
steps.zh: 双击这个 .msi 文件，接受许可协议。在“Custom Setup”（自定义安装）界面，确认“Add to PATH”处于开启状态，它默认就是开启的。“Set JAVA_HOME”是可选项，本指南用不到。

steps.en: Click Next, then Install. Allow the permission prompt. Click Finish.
steps.zh: 点“Next”，再点“Install”。出现权限提示时选择允许。最后点“Finish”。

steps.en: Open a new Command Prompt: press the Windows key, type cmd, press Enter. A window that was already open during the install cannot see the change, so always open a new one.
steps.zh: 打开一个新的命令提示符：按 Windows 键，输入 cmd，按回车。安装时就已经开着的窗口看不到这次改动，所以一定要开新窗口。

steps.en: Shortcut for people who like commands: instead of steps 1 to 4, run winget install EclipseAdoptium.Temurin.25.JDK in a terminal, then continue at step 5.
steps.zh: 喜欢用命令的人有个捷径：不做第 1 到 4 步，直接在终端里运行 winget install EclipseAdoptium.Temurin.25.JDK，然后从第 5 步接着做。

expect.en: Two commands, four lines in all. java -version prints three lines. The first starts with openjdk version and the number you installed, and the next two mention Temurin. javac -version prints one line such as javac 25.0.1. Your exact numbers will differ.
expect.zh: 两条命令，一共四行。java -version 输出三行：第一行以 openjdk version 和你安装的版本号开头，后两行里有 Temurin。javac -version 输出一行，例如 javac 25.0.1。具体数字会和这里不同。

steps.en: Find out which chip your Mac has: open the Apple menu, then About This Mac. A name such as Apple M1, M2 or M3 means Apple Silicon. A name that includes Intel means an Intel Mac.
steps.zh: 先弄清你的 Mac 用的是哪种芯片：打开苹果菜单，选“关于本机”。看到 Apple M1、M2、M3 之类的名字，就是 Apple 芯片；名字里有 Intel，就是 Intel 的 Mac。

steps.en: Open https://adoptium.net/temurin/releases/ . Pick the version marked LTS, the type JDK, the operating system macOS, and the architecture: aarch64 for Apple Silicon, or x64 for Intel. Download the file that ends in .pkg.
steps.zh: 打开 https://adoptium.net/temurin/releases/ 。选标有 LTS 的版本，类型选 JDK，操作系统选 macOS，架构：Apple 芯片选 aarch64，Intel 选 x64。下载以 .pkg 结尾的文件。

steps.en: Open the .pkg file. Click Continue and accept the license. Click Install and type your Mac password when asked. The JDK is placed in /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/.
steps.zh: 打开这个 .pkg 文件，点“继续”，接受许可协议，点“安装”，需要时输入 Mac 的登录密码。JDK 会被放进 /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/ 文件夹。

steps.en: Open Terminal: press Command and Space, type Terminal, press Enter. If a Terminal window was already open, open a new one. On macOS you do not edit PATH yourself, because the java and javac commands already look for installed JDKs.
steps.zh: 打开“终端”：按 Command 加空格，输入 Terminal，按回车。如果终端窗口在安装前就开着，请再开一个新的。macOS 上不用自己改 PATH，因为 java 和 javac 这两个命令会自动去找已安装的 JDK。

steps.en: Shortcut for people who use Homebrew: run brew install --cask temurin@25 instead of steps 2 and 3.
steps.zh: 用 Homebrew 的人有个捷径：不做第 2、3 步，直接运行 brew install --cask temurin@25。

expect.en: Four lines in all, as on Windows: three lines from java -version that start with openjdk version and mention Temurin, and one line from javac -version such as javac 25.0.1.
expect.zh: 和 Windows 一样，一共四行：java -version 输出三行，以 openjdk version 开头并提到 Temurin；javac -version 输出一行，例如 javac 25.0.1。

steps.en: Open a terminal. On many desktops the shortcut is Ctrl+Alt+T.
steps.zh: 打开终端。在很多桌面系统里，快捷键是 Ctrl+Alt+T。

steps.en:
Install the small tools that the next commands use:
sudo apt install -y wget apt-transport-https gpg
steps.zh:
先安装接下来的命令要用到的几个小工具：
sudo apt install -y wget apt-transport-https gpg

steps.en:
Download Adoptium's signing key, which lets apt check the packages:
wget -qO - https://packages.adoptium.net/artifactory/api/gpg/key/public | gpg --dearmor | sudo tee /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/adoptium.gpg > /dev/null
steps.zh:
下载 Adoptium 的签名密钥，apt 要靠它检查软件包：
wget -qO - https://packages.adoptium.net/artifactory/api/gpg/key/public | gpg --dearmor | sudo tee /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/adoptium.gpg > /dev/null

steps.en:
Add the Adoptium package repository (one long line):
echo "deb https://packages.adoptium.net/artifactory/deb $(awk -F= '/^VERSION_CODENAME/{print$2}' /etc/os-release) main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/adoptium.list
On Linux Mint, write UBUNTU_CODENAME in place of VERSION_CODENAME.
steps.zh:
添加 Adoptium 的软件源（这是很长的一行）：
echo "deb https://packages.adoptium.net/artifactory/deb $(awk -F= '/^VERSION_CODENAME/{print$2}' /etc/os-release) main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/adoptium.list
如果用的是 Linux Mint，把 VERSION_CODENAME 换成 UBUNTU_CODENAME。

steps.en:
Update the package list, then install the JDK:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install temurin-25-jdk
If the latest LTS is no longer 25, use that number instead. Install the jdk package, not the jre one, because the jre package has no javac.
steps.zh:
更新软件包列表，再安装 JDK：
sudo apt update
sudo apt install temurin-25-jdk
如果最新的 LTS 已经不是 25，就换成新的数字。要装 jdk 包，不要装 jre 包，因为 jre 包里没有 javac。

steps.en: Other systems: Fedora, RHEL and CentOS use dnf with Adoptium's own repository, described at adoptium.net/installation/linux. On Windows you can also use WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux): run wsl --install in an administrator PowerShell, restart, and follow these steps inside Ubuntu.
steps.zh: 其他系统：Fedora、RHEL、CentOS 用 dnf 加上 Adoptium 自己的软件源，做法写在 adoptium.net/installation/linux。在 Windows 上也可以用 WSL（Windows 的 Linux 子系统）：在管理员身份的 PowerShell 里运行 wsl --install，重启后在 Ubuntu 里照上面的步骤做。

expect.en: Four lines in all: three from java -version that start with openjdk version and mention Temurin, and one from javac -version such as javac 25.0.1.
expect.zh: 一共四行：java -version 输出三行，以 openjdk version 开头并提到 Temurin；javac -version 输出一行，例如 javac 25.0.1。

errors.symptom: 'javac' is not recognized as an internal or external command, operable program or batch file.

fix.en: Windows cannot find javac. Check these three causes in order. First, you opened the window before the install finished: close it and open a new one. Second, Java was not added to PATH: open Settings, then Apps, find Eclipse Temurin JDK, choose Modify, and switch on Add to PATH. Third, you installed a JRE, which can run programs but has no javac: install the JDK. PowerShell says it differently: The term 'javac' is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet, function, script file, or operable program. The meaning is the same.
fix.zh: Windows 找不到 javac。按顺序检查三个原因。第一，窗口是在安装完成之前打开的：关掉它，再开一个新的。第二，Java 没有被加进 PATH：打开“设置”，进入“应用”，找到 Eclipse Temurin JDK，选“修改”，把“Add to PATH”打开。第三，你装的是 JRE，它能运行程序但没有 javac：请安装 JDK。PowerShell 的说法不同：The term 'javac' is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet, function, script file, or operable program。意思是一样的。

fix.en: Your terminal cannot find javac. The zsh shell on macOS words it as zsh: command not found: javac, and macOS may instead say Unable to locate a Java Runtime. Install the JDK as shown above. If you just installed it, close the terminal and open a new one. If java -version works but javac does not, you installed a JRE instead of a JDK. On Linux, install temurin-25-jdk, not temurin-25-jre. Ubuntu may print Command 'javac' not found, but can be installed with: and a list of packages. You can follow the Temurin steps above instead of that list.
fix.zh: 终端找不到 javac。macOS 的 zsh 会写成 zsh: command not found: javac，macOS 也可能改说 Unable to locate a Java Runtime。请按上面的步骤安装 JDK。如果刚装完，先关掉终端再开一个新的。如果 java -version 能用而 javac 不能用，说明你装成了 JRE 而不是 JDK。在 Linux 上请装 temurin-25-jdk，不要装 temurin-25-jre。Ubuntu 可能会打印 Command 'javac' not found, but can be installed with: 和一串软件包。你可以不理那一串，改按上面的 Temurin 步骤来做。

fix.en: javac cannot see a file with that name in the folder your terminal is in. List the files with dir (Windows) or ls (macOS and Linux). Move into the folder that holds the file with cd, for example cd Desktop. Check the exact name. Windows can hide file extensions, so a file you named Main.java may really be Main.java.txt.
fix.zh: javac 在终端当前所在的文件夹里看不到这个名字的文件。用 dir（Windows）或 ls（macOS 和 Linux）列出文件，再用 cd 进入存放文件的文件夹，例如 cd Desktop。仔细核对文件名。Windows 可能把扩展名隐藏起来，所以你命名为 Main.java 的文件，实际上可能是 Main.java.txt。

errors.symptom: error: class Hello is public, should be declared in a file named Hello.java

fix.en: A public class must live in a file with exactly the same name, capital letters included. Here the class is Hello, so the file must be Hello.java. Rename the file, or rename the class to match the file. On a computer set to Chinese the message may read 错误: 类Hello是公共的, 应在名为 Hello.java 的文件中声明.
fix.zh: public 的类必须放在同名文件里，大小写也要一样。这里的类叫 Hello，所以文件必须叫 Hello.java。要么给文件改名，要么把类名改成和文件一致。在设置为中文的电脑上，这条信息可能显示为：错误: 类Hello是公共的, 应在名为 Hello.java 的文件中声明。

errors.symptom: Error: Could not find or load main class Main

fix.en: The java command cannot find Main.class. Check these causes. You have not compiled yet: run javac Main.java first. You are in a different folder from Main.class: use cd. You typed java Main.class: leave out the .class and type java Main. The capital letters differ: java main is not java Main. After an edit you must compile again. A second line, Caused by: java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: Main, may follow. On a Chinese-language system the first line may read 错误: 找不到或无法加载主类 Main.
fix.zh: java 命令找不到 Main.class。检查这几个原因。还没有编译：先运行 javac Main.java。你所在的文件夹和 Main.class 不在一起：用 cd 进入正确的文件夹。你输入了 java Main.class：去掉 .class，输入 java Main。大小写不一致：java main 不等于 java Main。改过文件之后要重新编译。后面可能还跟着第二行 Caused by: java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: Main。在中文系统上，第一行可能显示为：错误: 找不到或无法加载主类 Main。

errors.symptom: error: reached end of file while parsing

fix.en: Java reached the end of the file while it was still waiting for something. Nearly always it is a closing brace }. Every { needs its own }. Look at the last lines of the file, indent the code neatly, and count the braces. Many editors highlight the partner of a brace when the cursor is next to it. On a Chinese-language system the message may read 错误: 解析时已到达文件结尾.
fix.zh: Java 读到文件末尾时，还在等待某样东西，几乎总是一个右花括号 }。每个 { 都要有自己的 }。看看文件最后几行，把代码缩进整齐，再数一数花括号。很多编辑器在光标紧挨着花括号时，会高亮和它配对的那一个。在中文系统上，这条信息可能显示为：错误: 解析时已到达文件结尾。

fix.en: Java does not know a name you used. The lines under the message tell you which name (symbol) and where Java looked (location). Usual causes: a typo (totl instead of total), wrong capital letters (string instead of String, system instead of System), using a variable outside the braces where it was created, or a missing import line for a library class such as Arrays. Lesson 8 shows how to read these messages. On a Chinese-language system the message may read 错误: 找不到符号.
fix.zh: Java 不认识你用到的某个名字。信息下面几行会告诉你是哪个名字（symbol，符号），以及 Java 在哪里找过（location，位置）。常见原因：拼写错误（把 total 写成 totl）、大小写不对（把 String 写成 string，把 System 写成 system）、在变量被创建的花括号之外使用它，或者漏写了库类（例如 Arrays）的 import 行。第 8 课会教你怎样读这些信息。在中文系统上，这条信息可能显示为：错误: 找不到符号。

title.en: Source, compile, run: your first program
title.zh: 源代码、编译、运行：第一个程序

goal.en: You can say what source code, compile and run mean, and you can write, compile and run a program that prints text.
goal.zh: 你能说清源代码、编译和运行各是什么，并能自己写出、编译、运行一个打印文字的程序。

plain.en:
A program is a list of instructions for a computer. You write the list as text in a file. That text is called source code. A Java source file has a name that ends in .java.

A computer cannot follow Java text directly. A program called the compiler translates it first. The compiler for Java is javac. It reads Main.java and writes a new file, Main.class, which holds bytecode. Bytecode is a compact list of instructions made for Java's own virtual machine. The translating step is called compiling.

Then the Java Virtual Machine, or JVM, reads the bytecode and carries out the instructions. Starting it is called running the program. You start it with the command java.

So there are always two steps. You type them in a terminal, which is a window for typing commands (see Set up your computer):

javac Main.java
java Main

The first command compiles. The second one runs. Notice that the second command is just Main, with no .java and no .class, because you give the name of a class, not of a file. Newer JDKs (version 11 and later) also accept java Main.java, which does both steps at once. This guide uses two steps so you can see each of them.

If you change the source file, the old Main.class stays exactly as it was. Compile again before you run again. Forgetting this is the most common mistake on the first day.

Now the shape of a program. Java keeps all code inside classes. A class is a named container for code. The public class must have the same name as its file, so a class called Main goes in Main.java. Inside the class we write a method called main. A method is a named block of code that does one job. When you run a program, the JVM looks for main and starts there.

Inside a method, each instruction is a statement. Most statements end with a semicolon. Curly braces { } mark where a class or a method begins and ends. The statement System.out.println prints text and then moves to a new line. System.out.print does the same without moving to a new line. Text must be inside double quotation marks.

Java 25 also allows a much shorter program form. Your course uses the classic form shown here, which works on every version. To run an example on this page, press Run under it. You can press Edit code, change something, and press Run again.
plain.zh:
程序就是写给计算机的一串指令。你把这串指令写成文字，存在一个文件里。这些文字叫源代码。Java 源文件的名字以 .java 结尾。

计算机不能直接照着 Java 文字去做，要先由一个叫编译器的程序把它翻译一遍。Java 的编译器叫 javac。它读取 Main.java，写出一个新文件 Main.class，里面装的是字节码。字节码是一串紧凑的指令，专为 Java 自己的虚拟机准备。这个翻译的步骤叫编译。

接着，Java 虚拟机（Java Virtual Machine，简称 JVM）读取字节码，并执行里面的指令。启动它就叫运行程序。你用 java 这个命令来启动它。

所以永远是两步。你在终端里输入它们，终端就是用来输入命令的窗口（见“准备你的电脑”）：

javac Main.java
java Main

第一条命令编译，第二条命令运行。注意第二条只写 Main，没有 .java，也没有 .class，因为你给出的是类的名字，不是文件的名字。较新的 JDK（11 及以上）也接受 java Main.java，一次完成两步。本指南仍然分成两步，让你能看清每一步。

如果你改了源文件，旧的 Main.class 不会跟着变。要重新编译，再重新运行。忘了这一点，是第一天最常见的错误。

下面看程序的基本形状。Java 把所有代码都放在类里面。类是一个有名字的代码容器。public 的类必须和它的文件同名，所以叫 Main 的类放在 Main.java 里。类的里面写一个叫 main 的方法。方法是一段有名字、只做一件事的代码。运行程序时，JVM 会去找 main，并从那里开始。

在方法里，每一条指令叫一条语句。大多数语句以分号结尾。花括号 { } 标出类或方法从哪里开始、到哪里结束。语句 System.out.println 会打印文字，然后换到新的一行。System.out.print 做同样的事，但不换行。文字必须放在双引号里面。

Java 25 还允许一种短得多的程序写法。你的课程用的是这里的经典写法，它在所有版本上都能用。要在本页运行一个例子，点它下面的“运行”。你也可以点“修改代码”，改一点东西，再点一次“运行”。

meaning.en: The text of a program, written by a person, in a file ending in .java.

goal.en: You can declare variables of type int, double, boolean, char and String, change their values, and predict what division and + give.
goal.zh: 你能声明 int、double、boolean、char 和 String 类型的变量，修改它们的值，并预测除法和 + 的结果。

plain.en:
A variable is a named place in the computer's memory that holds one value. You choose the name. Java also needs to know what kind of value the variable may hold. That kind is called the variable's type.

These are the five types to learn first:
int: a whole number, such as 7 or -3.
double: a number with a decimal part, such as 1.5.
boolean: either true or false.
char: one character in single quotation marks, such as 'A'.
String: text in double quotation marks, such as "Mia". Write String with a capital S.

You declare a variable by writing its type, its name and a first value: int apples = 7; The = sign means "store the value on the right into the name on the left". It does not mean "is equal to", as in maths. Later you can store a new value: apples = apples + 1; Read it as "take the old value of apples, add 1, and store the result back in apples". You do not write the type again, because the variable already exists.

Java checks types before the program runs. It will not store 2.5 in an int, because the .5 would be lost. It also wants every variable to have a value before you use it.

For arithmetic you have + - * / and %, where % gives the remainder after division. If both sides of / are int, the answer is an int and the decimal part is cut off: 7 / 2 is 3, not 3.5. If one side is a double, the answer is a double: 7 / 2.0 is 3.5. Java does * and / before + and -, and otherwise works from left to right.

The + sign also joins text. Joining text is called concatenation. "Mia" + " is " + 7 gives the text Mia is 7. Because Java works from left to right, the order matters, as the mistakes below show.
plain.zh:
变量是计算机内存里一个有名字的位置，里面存放一个值。名字由你来起。Java 还需要知道这个变量允许存放哪一种值，这一种就叫变量的类型。

最先要学的五种类型是：
int：整数，例如 7 或 -3。
double：带小数部分的数，例如 1.5。
boolean：只有 true 或 false 两个值。
char：一个字符，写在单引号里，例如 'A'。
String：文字，写在双引号里，例如 "Mia"。String 的 S 要大写。

声明变量时，依次写出类型、名字和第一个值：int apples = 7; 其中的 = 号表示“把右边的值存进左边的名字里”。它不表示数学里的“等于”。之后你可以存入新的值：apples = apples + 1; 读作“取出 apples 现在的值，加 1，再把结果存回 apples”。这时不用再写类型，因为变量已经存在了。

Java 在程序运行之前就检查类型。它不会把 2.5 存进 int，因为 .5 会丢掉。它还要求每个变量在被使用之前先有一个值。

算术运算有 + - * / 和 %，其中 % 求除法的余数。如果 / 两边都是 int，结果就是 int，小数部分被直接去掉：7 / 2 是 3，不是 3.5。只要有一边是 double，结果就是 double：7 / 2.0 是 3.5。Java 先算 * 和 /，再算 + 和 -，其余情况按从左到右的顺序计算。

+ 号还能把文字连起来。把文字连起来叫拼接。"Mia" + " is " + 7 得到文字 Mia is 7。因为 Java 从左到右计算，所以顺序很重要，下面的常见错误会演示这一点。

title.en: Decisions and repeats: if and for
title.zh: 判断与重复：if 和 for

goal.en: You can make a program choose between two paths with if and else, and repeat work a set number of times with for.
goal.zh: 你能用 if 和 else 让程序在两条路径中选择，并用 for 让一段工作重复固定的次数。

plain.en:
Normally Java runs the statements from top to bottom, once each. Two tools change that. An if statement chooses whether to run some statements. A for statement repeats some statements.

An if statement has a condition in brackets, followed by a block. A block is a group of statements inside curly braces. The condition must be a boolean, which means true or false. If it is true, Java runs the block. If it is false, Java skips the block, or runs the block after else when there is one. The else part is optional. To test several cases in order, write another if after else. Java takes the first block whose condition is true and skips the rest.

Conditions usually come from comparisons: < (less than), <= (less than or equal), > (greater than), >= (greater than or equal), == (equal) and != (not equal). You can combine conditions: && means and, || means or, and ! means not. Watch the difference: two equals signs, ==, compare two values. One equals sign, =, stores a value.

A for loop repeats a block. A loop is any statement that runs a block again and again. The brackets of a for hold three parts separated by semicolons, as in for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++). The start, int i = 1, creates a counter named i and sets it to 1. The test, i <= 5, is checked before every round. When it is false, the loop ends. The step, i++, adds 1 to i after every round. It is short for i = i + 1. Likewise i-- subtracts 1.

Tracing means following a program by hand, writing down the value of each variable after each step. It is how you find out what code does without running it, and it is a skill worth practising on paper.
plain.zh:
通常 Java 把语句从上到下各运行一次。有两个工具可以改变这一点：if 语句决定要不要运行某些语句，for 语句让某些语句重复运行。

if 语句在括号里放一个条件，后面跟一个代码块。代码块是花括号里的一组语句。条件必须是 boolean，也就是 true 或 false。如果为 true，Java 运行这个代码块；如果为 false，Java 跳过它，有 else 的话就运行 else 后面的代码块。else 部分是可选的。要依次测试好几种情况，可以在 else 后面再写一个 if。Java 会选中第一个条件为 true 的代码块，并跳过其余的。

条件通常来自比较：<（小于）、<=（小于或等于）、>（大于）、>=（大于或等于）、==（等于）和 !=（不等于）。条件还可以组合：&& 表示并且，|| 表示或者，! 表示取反。注意区别：两个等号 == 是比较两个值，一个等号 = 是存入一个值。

for 循环让一个代码块重复运行。循环就是让代码块一遍又一遍运行的语句。for 的括号里有三部分，用分号隔开，例如 for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++)。起点 int i = 1 创建一个叫 i 的计数器并设为 1。测试 i <= 5 在每一轮开始前检查，变成 false 时循环结束。步进 i++ 在每一轮结束后让 i 加 1，它是 i = i + 1 的简写。同样，i-- 表示减 1。

跟踪的意思是用手把程序走一遍，每一步之后写下每个变量的值。这样不用运行代码也能知道它做了什么，这是值得在纸上多练习的一项技能。

example.output:
1 is odd, total 1
2 is even, total 3
3 is odd, total 6
4 is even, total 10
5 is odd, total 15
final total 15

en: int total = 0; creates the running total before the loop starts.
for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++) starts the loop. i begins at 1, and the block runs as long as i <= 5.
Round 1: i is 1, so total becomes 0 + 1 = 1. The remainder 1 % 2 is 1, not 0, so the condition i % 2 == 0 is false. The else block prints 1 is odd, total 1.
Round 2: i is 2, and total becomes 3. 2 % 2 is 0, so the condition is true and the first block prints 2 is even, total 3.
Rounds 3, 4 and 5 add 3, 4 and 5, so the totals are 6, 10 and 15.
After round 5, i++ makes i equal to 6. The test 6 <= 5 is false, so the loop ends. The last println is outside the braces of the loop, so it runs once, after the loop.
zh: int total = 0; 在循环开始之前创建累计的总和。
for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++) 开始循环。i 从 1 开始，只要 i <= 5，代码块就继续运行。
第 1 轮：i 是 1，所以 total 变成 0 + 1 = 1。余数 1 % 2 是 1，不是 0，所以条件 i % 2 == 0 为 false，运行 else 代码块，打印 1 is odd, total 1。
第 2 轮：i 是 2，total 变成 3。2 % 2 是 0，条件为 true，运行第一个代码块，打印 2 is even, total 3。
第 5 轮之后，i++ 让 i 变成 6。测试 6 <= 5 为 false，循环结束。最后一条 println 在循环的花括号之外，所以只在循环结束后运行一次。

why.en: One equals sign stores a value. It does not compare. javac says: error: incompatible types: int cannot be converted to boolean, because the condition must be true or false. To compare, use two equals signs.
why.zh: 一个等号是存入一个值，不是比较。javac 会报：error: incompatible types: int cannot be converted to boolean，因为条件必须是 true 或 false。要比较，请用两个等号。

why.en: The semicolon right after the brackets is an empty statement. It is the whole body of the loop, so the loop repeats nothing three times. The block below it is not part of the loop, so it runs once. The program prints hi one time, not three times.
why.zh: 括号后面紧跟的分号是一条空语句，它就是整个循环体，所以循环把“什么也不做”重复了三遍。下面的代码块不属于循环，只运行一次。程序只打印一次 hi，而不是三次。

why.en: The test i < 5 becomes false when i reaches 5, so the loop stops before printing 5. It prints 1, 2, 3 and 4. Decide whether the last value should be included. If it should, use <=.
why.zh: i 到 5 时测试 i < 5 变成 false，所以循环在打印 5 之前就停了，只打印 1、2、3、4。要先想清楚最后一个值要不要包括进来。要包括的话，就用 <=。

why.en: Without braces, only the first statement after if belongs to it. The line that prints done is outside the if and always runs, even when x is not positive, although the indentation suggests otherwise. Java ignores indentation. Always use braces.
why.zh: 不写花括号的话，if 后面只有第一条语句属于它。打印 done 的那一行在 if 之外，总是会运行，即使 x 不是正数也一样，尽管缩进看上去不是这样。Java 不看缩进。请总是写上花括号。

q.zh: 写一个条件：当 age 至少为 18 且小于 65 时为 true。

a.en: age >= 18 && age < 65. Both parts must be true, so they are joined with &&. Writing 18 <= age < 65 does not work in Java.
a.zh: age >= 18 && age < 65。两部分必须同时为 true，所以用 && 连接。像数学那样写成 18 <= age < 65，在 Java 里是不行的。

title.en: Methods: naming a piece of work
title.zh: 方法：给一段工作起名字

goal.en: You can write a method with parameters and a return value, and call it from main.
goal.zh: 你能写出带形参和返回值的方法，并在 main 里调用它。

plain.en:
A method is a named block of code. You write it once and use it as many times as you like. Using it is called calling it. Methods save you from copying the same lines again and again, and a good name tells the reader what the lines do.

A method has four parts. In static int square(int n) { return n * n; } they are these. The return type, int, says what kind of value comes back. The name is square. The parameter list, (int n), declares the inputs: a parameter is a variable that receives an input. The body, in braces, is the code that runs. The word static is needed for now because main is static. Leave it in for the time being. Lesson 7 shows methods without it.

To call a method, write its name and, in brackets, the values to give it: square(6). These values are the arguments. Java copies each argument into the matching parameter. The statement return sends a value back and ends the method. The call square(6) then stands for the value 36, and you can use it anywhere a value fits, for example inside println, or on the right of an = sign.

Some methods give nothing back. Their return type is void, and they need no return statement. In the example, greet is like this.

A variable created inside a method, parameters included, is local. It exists only while the method runs, and no other method can see it. Because arguments are copied, changing a parameter inside a method does not change the variable in the code that called the method, which is known as the caller. The example shows this with n.
plain.zh:
方法是一段有名字的代码。你只写一遍，却可以用任意多次。用它叫作调用它。有了方法，就不必把同样的几行代码复制一遍又一遍，而一个好名字还能告诉读者这几行代码是做什么的。

方法有四个部分。以 static int square(int n) { return n * n; } 为例：返回类型 int 说明返回的是哪一种值；名字是 square；形参列表 (int n) 声明输入，形参就是接收一个输入的变量；花括号里的方法体是运行的代码。现在必须写 static，因为 main 是 static 的，眼下先保留它。第 7 课会讲不带 static 的方法。

调用方法时，写出它的名字，并在括号里放上要交给它的值：square(6)。这些值叫实参。Java 把每个实参复制给对应的形参。return 语句把一个值送回去，并结束这个方法。于是 square(6) 就代表值 36，凡是能放值的地方都能用它，例如放在 println 里面，或者放在 = 号的右边。

有些方法什么也不返回。它们的返回类型是 void，也不需要 return 语句。例子中的 greet 就是这样。

在方法里创建的变量（包括形参）都是局部变量。它只在方法运行期间存在，别的方法看不到它。因为实参是被复制过去的，所以在方法里修改形参，不会改变调用它的代码（称为调用者）里的变量。例子里用 n 演示了这一点。

meaning.en: A method is a named block of code. To call it is to run it by writing its name with brackets.
meaning.zh: 方法是有名字的一段代码。调用它，就是写出名字和括号来运行它。

meaning.en: A parameter is a variable in the method's header that receives an input. An argument is the value you pass in a call.
meaning.zh: 形参是方法头里接收输入的变量；实参是调用时传进去的值。

meaning.en: The value a method sends back with return. Its kind is the return type; void means nothing comes back.
meaning.zh: 方法用 return 送回的值。它的种类是返回类型；void 表示什么也不返回。

meaning.en: A variable that exists only inside one method while it runs.
meaning.zh: 只在某个方法运行期间、只在这个方法里面存在的变量。

example.output:
Hello, Iris!
6 squared is 36
16
n is 5, bigger is 6

en: greet is a void method. It prints and gives nothing back. Its parameter name receives the text it is given.
square takes an int and returns an int. return n * n; sends the product back to the caller.
addOne changes its own copy of n, and then returns it.
In main, greet("Iris") copies the argument "Iris" into name, and Hello, Iris! is printed.
square(6) runs the body with n set to 6 and gives back 36, which is stored in result.
In square(square(2)) the inner call runs first and gives 4. Then the outer call squares 4 and gives 16.
main has its own n, which is 5. addOne(n) copies 5 into a separate n inside addOne and changes that copy to 6. main's n is still 5. The returned 6 is stored in bigger.
zh: greet 是 void 方法。它只打印，不返回任何东西。它的形参 name 接收传给它的文字。
square 接收一个 int，返回一个 int。return n * n; 把乘积送回给调用者。
addOne 修改的是它自己的那份 n，然后把它返回。
在 main 里，greet("Iris") 把实参 "Iris" 复制给 name，于是打印出 Hello, Iris!。
square(6) 在 n 等于 6 的情况下运行方法体，返回 36，并存进 result。
在 square(square(2)) 里，里面那次调用先运行，得到 4；外面那次调用再把 4 平方，得到 16。
main 有自己的 n，值是 5。addOne(n) 把 5 复制进 addOne 里另一个独立的 n，并把那份副本改成 6。main 里的 n 仍然是 5。返回的 6 被存进 bigger。

why.en: The method promises to give back an int but never does. javac says: error: missing return statement. Every path through a method that has a return type must end in a return.
why.zh: 方法承诺要返回一个 int，却从来没有返回。javac 会报：error: missing return statement。凡是有返回类型的方法，每一条执行路径都必须以 return 结束。

why.en: The call works out 6 and returns it, but nothing stores the answer. The parameter was a copy, so n in main is still 5. The program prints 5. Store the returned value.
why.zh: 这次调用算出了 6 并把它返回，但没有任何东西把答案存起来。形参只是一份副本，所以 main 里的 n 仍然是 5，程序打印 5。要把返回值存起来。

why.en: main is static, so it can call only other static methods of the same class without an object. javac says: error: non-static method square(int) cannot be referenced from a static context. For now, add static. Lesson 7 explains methods without it.
why.zh: main 是 static 的，没有对象时，它只能调用同一个类里同样是 static 的方法。javac 会报：error: non-static method square(int) cannot be referenced from a static context。眼下请加上 static。第 7 课会讲不带 static 的方法。

q.en: Write a method max2 that takes two ints and returns the larger one.
q.zh: 写一个方法 max2，接收两个 int，返回其中较大的那个。

q.en: Predict what is printed: static int twice(int x) { x = x * 2; return x; } and then, in main, int a = 4; twice(a); System.out.println(a);
q.zh: 预测打印的内容：static int twice(int x) { x = x * 2; return x; }，然后在 main 里 int a = 4; twice(a); System.out.println(a);

a.en: 4. The parameter x is a copy of a. Doubling x does not touch a, and the returned 8 was never stored.
a.zh: 打印 4。形参 x 是 a 的副本。把 x 翻倍不会影响 a，而返回的 8 根本没有被存起来。

q.en: Fix this method: static void add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
q.zh: 修正这个方法：static void add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }

a.en: javac says: error: incompatible types: unexpected return value. A void method cannot return a value. Change void to int: static int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
a.zh: javac 会报：error: incompatible types: unexpected return value。void 方法不能返回值。把 void 改成 int：static int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }

title.en: Arrays: many values in a row
title.zh: 数组：排成一行的多个值

goal.en: You can create an array, read and change its elements by index, loop over it, and print it.
goal.zh: 你能创建数组，按下标读取和修改它的元素，用循环遍历它，并把它打印出来。

plain.en:
An array holds a fixed number of values of the same type, stored in a row. Picture a row of numbered boxes. Each box is an element. The number of a box is its index. Indexes start at 0, not at 1. An array with 3 elements has the indexes 0, 1 and 2.

You can create an array with values: int[] scores = {80, 95, 70}; The type int[] means "array of int". Or you can create one of a given size: int[] blanks = new int[3]; Every element then starts with a default value: 0 for numbers, false for boolean, and null for String. null means "no object".

Read an element with scores[0]. Change one with scores[1] = 100; The size is scores.length. Notice that length has no brackets after it. The size can never change after the array is created.

The last valid index is length - 1. An index outside 0 to length - 1 is not a compile error. The program stops when it reaches that line, with an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException. An exception is Java's way of reporting a problem while the program runs. Lesson 8 shows how to read one.

To visit every element, loop over the indexes: for (int i = 0; i < scores.length; i++). There is also a shorter form, the for-each loop: for (int s : scores) { ... } Read it as "for each int s in scores". The variable s takes each value in turn. Use it when you do not need the index.

Printing an array directly shows a code such as [I@6d06d69c, not the values. To see the values, put import java.util.Arrays; above the class and print Arrays.toString(scores). An import line tells Java which library class you mean. The library is the large collection of ready-made classes that comes with Java.
plain.zh:
数组存放固定数量的同类型的值，它们排成一行。想象一排有编号的格子。每个格子是一个元素，格子的编号叫下标。下标从 0 开始，不是从 1 开始。有 3 个元素的数组，下标是 0、1、2。

创建数组时可以直接给出值：int[] scores = {80, 95, 70}; 类型 int[] 表示“int 的数组”。也可以只指定大小：int[] blanks = new int[3]; 这时每个元素都有一个默认值：数字是 0，boolean 是 false，String 是 null。null 表示“没有对象”。

用 scores[0] 读取一个元素，用 scores[1] = 100; 修改一个元素。数组的大小是 scores.length。注意 length 后面没有括号。数组一旦创建，大小就不能再改变。

最后一个有效下标是 length - 1。下标超出 0 到 length - 1 的范围，不会造成编译错误，而是程序运行到那一行时停下来，报 ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException。异常是 Java 报告“程序运行时出了问题”的方式。第 8 课会教你怎样读懂它。

要访问每一个元素，可以按下标循环：for (int i = 0; i < scores.length; i++)。还有一种更短的写法，叫 for-each 循环：for (int s : scores) { ... } 读作“对 scores 里的每个 int s”。变量 s 依次取到每一个值。不需要下标的时候用它。

直接打印数组，显示的是类似 [I@6d06d69c 的代号，而不是里面的值。想看到值，就在类的上方写 import java.util.Arrays;，然后打印 Arrays.toString(scores)。import 这一行告诉 Java 你指的是哪个库里的类。库是 Java 自带的、大量现成的类的集合。

meaning.en: A fixed number of values of one type, stored in a row.
meaning.zh: 固定数量、同一类型的值，排成一行存放。

meaning.en: An element is one value in the array. Its index is its position, counted from 0.
meaning.zh: 元素是数组里的一个值；它的下标是它的位置，从 0 开始数。

meaning.en: A report that something went wrong while the program was running.
meaning.zh: 程序运行时出了问题的一种报告。

meaning.en: A line at the top of a file that names a library class you want to use.
meaning.zh: 写在文件开头的一行，指明你要使用的库里的类。

example.output:
first = 80
length = 3
[80, 100, 70]
total = 250
score: 80
score: 100
score: 70
[0, 0, 0]

en: import java.util.Arrays; makes the library class Arrays available. It goes above the class.
int[] scores = {80, 95, 70}; creates an array of three ints. scores[0] is 80, scores[1] is 95 and scores[2] is 70. scores.length is 3.
scores[1] = 100; replaces the element at index 1. Arrays.toString turns the array into readable text: [80, 100, 70].
The first loop uses i as the index, from 0 up to 2. When i becomes 3, the test i < scores.length is false, so index 3 is never touched. It adds 80, 100 and 70 and gets 250.
The for-each loop visits the three values in order. s holds one value at a time.
new int[3] makes three elements, and all of them start as 0.
zh: import java.util.Arrays; 让库里的 Arrays 类可以使用。它写在类的上方。
int[] scores = {80, 95, 70}; 创建了一个有三个 int 的数组。scores[0] 是 80，scores[1] 是 95，scores[2] 是 70。scores.length 是 3。
scores[1] = 100; 替换下标 1 的元素。Arrays.toString 把数组变成可读的文字：[80, 100, 70]。
第一个循环用 i 作下标，从 0 到 2。i 变成 3 时，测试 i < scores.length 为 false，所以下标 3 永远不会被碰到。它把 80、100、70 加起来，得到 250。
for-each 循环按顺序访问这三个值，s 每次拿到其中一个。
new int[3] 创建三个元素，它们一开始都是 0。

why.en: With 3 elements the last index is 2, but i reaches 3. The program prints the three scores and then stops with: Exception in thread "main" java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 3 out of bounds for length 3. The line after it names your file and line number. Java 8 prints only the number 3 after the colon. Use < with length.
why.zh: 数组有 3 个元素，最后一个下标是 2，而 i 会取到 3。程序先打印出三个分数，然后停下来，报：Exception in thread "main" java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 3 out of bounds for length 3。它下面一行会写出你的文件名和行号。Java 8 在冒号后只会打印数字 3。和 length 比较时请用 <。

why.en: This does not copy the boxes. It gives the same array a second name. Changing copy[0] also changes scores[0], so printing scores now shows [0, 95, 70]. To make a real copy, use Arrays.copyOf.
why.zh: 这并没有复制格子，只是给同一个数组起了第二个名字。修改 copy[0] 同时也改了 scores[0]，所以现在打印 scores 会显示 [0, 95, 70]。要得到真正的副本，请用 Arrays.copyOf。

mistakes.right:
int[] copy = Arrays.copyOf(scores, scores.length);
copy[0] = 0;    // scores is unchanged

why.en: For an array, length is a value, not a method, so it takes no brackets. javac says: error: cannot find symbol, followed by symbol: method length(). Strings are different, as lesson 6 shows: they do use brackets.
why.zh: 对数组来说，length 是一个值，不是方法，所以不带括号。javac 会报：error: cannot find symbol，后面跟着 symbol: method length()。字符串则不同，第 6 课会讲到：它要带括号。

q.en: Predict what is printed: int[] a = {5, 6, 7}; a[0] = a[2]; System.out.println(Arrays.toString(a));
q.zh: 预测打印的内容：int[] a = {5, 6, 7}; a[0] = a[2]; System.out.println(Arrays.toString(a));

a.en: [7, 6, 7]. The statement copies the value at index 2 into index 0. The 5 is overwritten.
a.zh: [7, 6, 7]。这条语句把下标 2 的值复制到下标 0，原来的 5 被覆盖了。

q.en: Write a loop that prints the elements of scores from last to first.
q.zh: 写一个循环，从最后一个到第一个，依次打印 scores 的元素。

q.en: How many elements does new int[5] have, and what is the largest valid index?
q.zh: new int[5] 有几个元素？最大的有效下标是多少？

a.en: It has 5 elements, all 0. The valid indexes are 0 to 4, so the largest is 4. Using index 5 stops the program with an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
a.zh: 它有 5 个元素，全是 0。有效下标是 0 到 4，最大的是 4。使用下标 5 会让程序停下来，并报 ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException。

title.zh: 字符串，以及 == 与 equals 的区别

goal.en: You can use common String methods and compare two strings correctly.
goal.zh: 你能使用常用的 String 方法，并正确地比较两个字符串。

plain.en:
A String is a piece of text, made of characters in order. You write a string value in double quotation marks. String is not a simple type like int. It is a class, and every string value is an object. An object is a value created from a class, and it lives somewhere in memory. A variable of type String does not hold the text itself. It holds a reference, which says where the object is. Think of a reference as a label that points to the object.

You use an object's methods with a dot, as in word.length(). These are useful: length() gives the number of characters. charAt(i) gives the character at index i, counted from 0, like an array. substring(a, b) gives the characters from index a up to, but not including, index b. indexOf("l") gives the index of the first match, or -1 if there is none. toUpperCase() and toLowerCase() change capital letters. Note that length() for a String has brackets, unlike length for an array.

A String can never be changed after it is made. Methods such as toUpperCase() do not change the original. They return a new String. To keep the result, store it: word = word.toUpperCase();

Now == and equals. For references, == asks: do these two names point at the very same object? It does not ask whether the text matches. Two different objects can hold the same letters. The method equals asks: do these two strings contain the same characters? That is nearly always what you mean. So compare strings with a.equals(b), never with a == b. Use equalsIgnoreCase to ignore capital letters.

== sometimes seems to work. Java stores identical string literals (text typed directly in the code) only once, so two literals with the same text are the same object. But as soon as the text comes from somewhere else, such as the keyboard, a file or a calculation, == gives false. A bug that works in your tests and fails later is the worst kind. Always use equals.
plain.zh:
String 是一段文字，由按顺序排列的字符组成。字符串的值写在双引号里。String 不是 int 那样的简单类型，它是一个类，每个字符串值都是一个对象。对象是由类创建出来的值，它存放在内存的某个地方。String 类型的变量里存放的不是文字本身，而是一个引用，说明对象在哪里。可以把引用想成指向对象的一张标签。

用点号来使用对象的方法，例如 word.length()。下面这些很有用：length() 给出字符的个数。charAt(i) 给出下标 i 处的字符，下标像数组一样从 0 开始数。substring(a, b) 给出从下标 a 到下标 b 之前的字符，不包括下标 b。indexOf("l") 给出第一次匹配的下标，没有匹配就给出 -1。toUpperCase() 和 toLowerCase() 改变大小写。注意，String 的 length() 带括号，这一点和数组的 length 不同。

String 一旦创建就永远不能改变。toUpperCase() 这样的方法不会改变原来的字符串，而是返回一个新的 String。想保留结果，就要把它存起来：word = word.toUpperCase();

下面讲 == 和 equals。对引用来说，== 问的是：这两个名字指向的是不是同一个对象？它不问文字是否一样。两个不同的对象可以装着相同的字母。equals 方法问的是：这两个字符串包含的字符是否相同？这几乎总是你真正想问的。所以比较字符串要用 a.equals(b)，永远不要用 a == b。要忽略大小写，用 equalsIgnoreCase。

== 有时候看上去能用。Java 对相同的字符串字面量（直接写在代码里的文字）只存一份，所以文字相同的两个字面量就是同一个对象。但是一旦文字来自别处，例如键盘、文件或者某次计算，== 就会得到 false。在测试里正常、之后才出错的 bug 是最糟糕的一种。所以请永远使用 equals。

meaning.en: Text made of characters in order. In Java it is a class, and each value is an object.
meaning.zh: 按顺序排列的字符组成的文字。在 Java 里它是一个类，每个值都是一个对象。

meaning.en: An object is a value created from a class. A reference tells where the object is.
meaning.zh: 对象是由类创建出来的值；引用说明对象在哪里。

meaning.en: A value written directly in the code, such as "hello" or 42.
meaning.zh: 直接写在代码里的值，例如 "hello" 或 42。

meaning.en: Cannot be changed after it is made. A String is immutable.
meaning.zh: 创建之后不能再改变。String 是不可变的。

example.output:
same text? true
same object? false
HELLO hello
5
e
el
2
ignoring case? true

en: word is a literal. new String("hello") builds a second, separate object with the same letters. We pretend that this text came from the keyboard.
equals compares the letters, so it gives true.
== asks whether word and typed are the same object. They are two objects, so it gives false. The brackets around word == typed are needed, because otherwise + would be done first.
toUpperCase() returns a new string, HELLO. word itself is unchanged, as the same line shows.
length() is 5. charAt(1) is e, because counting starts at 0 and h is index 0.
substring(1, 3) takes the characters at indexes 1 and 2, but not 3. The result is el.
indexOf("l") finds the first l at index 2. equalsIgnoreCase treats hello and HELLO as the same.
zh: word 是一个字面量。new String("hello") 另外创建了一个独立的对象，里面的字母一样。我们假装这段文字来自键盘。
equals 比较字母，所以得到 true。
== 问的是 word 和 typed 是不是同一个对象。它们是两个对象，所以得到 false。word == typed 外面的括号是必需的，否则会先做 + 运算。
toUpperCase() 返回一个新字符串 HELLO。word 本身没有变，同一行的输出就能看出来。
length() 是 5。charAt(1) 是 e，因为从 0 开始数，h 的下标是 0。
substring(1, 3) 取下标 1 和 2 的字符，不包括 3，结果是 el。
indexOf("l") 找到第一个 l，下标是 2。equalsIgnoreCase 把 hello 和 HELLO 当作相同。

why.en: This asks whether answer is the same object as the literal. If the text in answer was typed or built, the result is false even when it says yes. Use equals. Writing the literal first, "yes".equals(answer), also avoids a crash when answer is null, which means "no object at all", because calling a method on null stops the program.
why.zh: 这是在问 answer 和这个字面量是不是同一个对象。如果 answer 里的文字是键盘输入或拼出来的，即使内容是 yes，结果也是 false。请用 equals。把字面量写在前面，"yes".equals(answer)，还能避免 answer 是 null（表示“根本没有对象”）时程序崩溃，因为对 null 调用方法会让程序停止。

why.en: toUpperCase returns a new String and leaves name alone. Nothing stored the new String, so name is unchanged and the capital letters are lost.
why.zh: toUpperCase 返回一个新的 String，name 本身不变。没有任何东西把这个新 String 存起来，所以 name 没有改变，大写的结果也丢掉了。

why.en: The end index is not included. substring(1, 3) takes indexes 1 and 2 and gives el. To include index 3, the end must be 4.
why.zh: 结束下标是不包括的。substring(1, 3) 取下标 1 和 2，得到 el。想包括下标 3，结束下标就要写 4。

q.en: Predict what is printed: String s = "Java"; System.out.println(s.substring(1, 3)); System.out.println(s.charAt(0)); System.out.println(s.length());
q.zh: 预测打印的内容：String s = "Java"; System.out.println(s.substring(1, 3)); System.out.println(s.charAt(0)); System.out.println(s.length());

title.en: Your first class, with a constructor
title.zh: 第一个类，以及构造方法

goal.en: You can write a small class with fields, a constructor and methods, create objects from it with new, and call their methods.
goal.zh: 你能写一个带字段、构造方法和方法的小类，用 new 创建它的对象，并调用对象的方法。

plain.en:
So far you used types that Java provides. A class lets you make your own type. A class is a blueprint: it says what data each object has and what each object can do. An object is one thing built from the blueprint. One class, such as Player, can make many objects, and each object has its own data.

The data are called fields. A field is a variable that belongs to an object. You declare it inside the class but outside every method. We mark fields private. private means that only code inside the same class may use the field. This protects the data, and other code must go through the class's methods.

A method without the word static works on one particular object. Calling addPoints(5) on Leon's object changes Leon's score and nobody else's. Inside the class, such a method uses the fields by their names.

A constructor is a special method that runs when an object is created with new. It has the same name as the class and no return type, not even void. Its job is to give the fields their first values. new Player("Leon") creates the object, runs the constructor with "Leon" as the argument, and gives you a reference to the new object.

Inside the constructor, the parameter and the field may both be called name. Writing this.name means "the name field of this object". Writing name alone means the parameter. So this.name = name; stores the argument in the field.

Where does a class go? In real projects each class gets its own file, named after it. To keep this example in one file, the extra class goes above public class Main. Only the class called Main may be public there.
plain.zh:
到目前为止，你用的都是 Java 自带的类型。有了类，你就能做出自己的类型。类是一张蓝图：它说明每个对象有哪些数据、每个对象能做什么。对象是按蓝图造出来的一个具体的东西。一个类（例如 Player）可以造出许多对象，每个对象都有自己的数据。

这些数据叫字段。字段是属于某个对象的变量。你在类里面、所有方法外面声明它。我们把字段标成 private。private 表示只有同一个类里面的代码才能使用这个字段。这样数据就受到了保护，其他代码必须通过这个类的方法来使用它。

不带 static 的方法是针对某一个具体的对象工作的。对 Leon 的对象调用 addPoints(5)，改变的是 Leon 的分数，不会影响别人。在类的内部，这样的方法直接用名字使用字段。

构造方法是一种特殊的方法，用 new 创建对象时它会运行。它的名字和类名相同，没有返回类型，连 void 也不写。它的工作是给字段赋上最初的值。new Player("Leon") 会创建对象，以 "Leon" 作为实参运行构造方法，并把指向新对象的引用交给你。

在构造方法里，形参和字段可能都叫 name。写 this.name 表示“这个对象的 name 字段”，单独写 name 表示形参。所以 this.name = name; 的作用是把实参存进字段。

类放在哪里呢？在真正的项目里，每个类都有自己的文件，文件以类命名。为了让这个例子留在同一个文件里，多出来的类要写在 public class Main 的上方。在这种写法下，只有叫 Main 的类可以是 public 的。

meaning.en: A class is a blueprint. An object is one thing built from it with new.
meaning.zh: 类是蓝图；对象是用 new 按蓝图造出来的一个具体的东西。

meaning.en: A variable that belongs to an object, declared inside the class and outside every method.
meaning.zh: 属于某个对象的变量，声明在类里面、所有方法外面。

meaning.en: A special method with the class's name and no return type. It runs when new creates an object and sets up the fields.
meaning.zh: 一种特殊的方法，名字与类相同，没有返回类型。new 创建对象时它会运行，负责设置字段。

meaning.en: A name for the object whose method is running. this.name is that object's field.
meaning.zh: 指代正在运行其方法的那个对象。this.name 就是这个对象的 name 字段。

meaning.en: Only code inside the same class may use it.
meaning.zh: 只有同一个类里面的代码才能使用它。

example.output:
Leon has 8 points
Mia has 10 points

en: class Player { starts the blueprint. It is not public, so the same file may also hold public class Main.
private String name; and private int score; are the fields. Every Player object gets its own pair.
Player(String name) is the constructor: the class's name and no return type. this.name = name; stores the argument in the field. this.score = 0; starts the score at zero.
addPoints(int points) adds to this object's score. It is not static, so it works on whichever object it is called on.
describe() builds a String from the fields and returns it.
In main, new Player("Leon") creates one object and new Player("Mia") creates another. leon and mia are variables that refer to them.
leon.addPoints(5) changes only Leon's object. After 5 and 3, Leon has 8. Mia's object is untouched and gets its own 10. describe() is called on each object, so each prints its own data.
zh: class Player { 开始定义这张蓝图。它不是 public 的，所以同一个文件里还可以放 public class Main。
private String name; 和 private int score; 是字段。每个 Player 对象都有自己的一对。
Player(String name) 是构造方法：名字是类名，没有返回类型。this.name = name; 把实参存进字段。this.score = 0; 让分数从零开始。
addPoints(int points) 给这个对象的分数加分。它不是 static 的，所以对哪个对象调用，它就为哪个对象工作。
describe() 用字段拼出一个 String 并返回。
在 main 里，new Player("Leon") 创建一个对象，new Player("Mia") 创建另一个。leon 和 mia 是引用它们的变量。
leon.addPoints(5) 只改变 Leon 的对象。加了 5 再加 3 之后，Leon 是 8 分。Mia 的对象没有受影响，她自己得到 10 分。describe() 对每个对象各调用一次，所以各自打印自己的数据。

why.en: Without new, Java looks for an ordinary method called Player and cannot find one. javac says: error: cannot find symbol, with symbol: method Player(String). Create objects with new.
why.zh: 没有 new，Java 就去找一个叫 Player 的普通方法，找不到。javac 会报：error: cannot find symbol，并附带 symbol: method Player(String)。创建对象要用 new。

why.en: A return type, even void, turns it into an ordinary method that happens to be called Player. The class then has no constructor that takes a String, and new Player("Leon") fails with: error: constructor Player in class Player cannot be applied to given types; and required: no arguments, found: String.
why.zh: 加上返回类型（哪怕是 void），它就变成了一个碰巧叫 Player 的普通方法。这样类里就没有接收 String 的构造方法了，new Player("Leon") 会失败：error: constructor Player in class Player cannot be applied to given types;，并附带 required: no arguments 和 found: String。

why.en: Both sides are the parameter, so this assigns the parameter to itself. The field name is never set and keeps its default value, null. No error appears. describe() then prints null has 0 points. Put this. in front of the field.
why.zh: 两边都是形参，所以这是把形参赋给它自己。字段 name 从来没有被设置，保持默认值 null。不会出现任何报错，describe() 打印出来的是 null has 0 points。要在字段前面写上 this.。

q.en: Add a method getScore() to Player that returns the score as an int. Then write the line in main that prints Mia's score.
q.zh: 给 Player 加一个方法 getScore()，把分数作为 int 返回。再写出 main 里打印 Mia 分数的那一行。

q.en: Predict what is printed after these lines are added at the end of main: Player noah = new Player("Noah"); System.out.println(noah.describe());
q.zh: 在 main 的末尾加上下面两行后，预测打印什么：Player noah = new Player("Noah"); System.out.println(noah.describe());

a.en: Noah has 0 points. The constructor set score to 0 and addPoints was never called on this object.
a.zh: 打印 Noah has 0 points。构造方法把 score 设成了 0，而且从未对这个对象调用过 addPoints。

q.en: What does javac say if main contains leon.score = 100; and why?
q.zh: 如果 main 里有 leon.score = 100;，javac 会说什么？为什么？

a.en: error: score has private access in Player. The field is private, so code outside Player may not use it. Change the score through a method such as addPoints instead.
a.zh: error: score has private access in Player。这个字段是 private 的，Player 之外的代码不能使用它。应该改成通过 addPoints 这样的方法来改变分数。

title.en: Reading a compile error and a stack trace
title.zh: 读懂编译错误和堆栈跟踪

goal.en: You can find the line and the cause in a javac error message and in an exception stack trace.
goal.zh: 你能在 javac 的报错信息和异常的堆栈跟踪里，找到出错的行和原因。

plain.en:
Programs go wrong in three ways. A compile error means javac refuses to build the program, and nothing runs. A runtime error means the program starts, and then Java stops it at some line and prints a stack trace. A wrong answer means the program runs to the end but prints the wrong thing, and Java says nothing. The first two come with a message. This lesson is about reading those messages. The mistakes below show real ones.

Read a compile error from the top. The first line has three parts: the file and line number (such as Main.java:4), the word error, and what is wrong (such as cannot find symbol). The next line repeats the code from that line, with a caret ^ under the spot where Java got stuck. Some errors add detail lines, such as symbol: variable totl and location: class Main, which say which name Java does not know and where it looked. The last line counts the errors.

Three habits help. Fix the first error first, because later ones are often caused by it. A single missing brace can produce a dozen. Compile again after each fix. Next, the line number is where Java noticed the problem, and the real mistake can be a line above. Finally, treat the message as a hint, not a diagnosis. cannot find symbol only says that Java does not know a name.

A stack trace appears when an exception is not handled. An exception is an event that means something went wrong while the program was running, such as dividing by zero or using an index outside an array. The program stops at that point. The trace begins with a line that names the exception and gives a message. Then come lines that start with at. Each one is a method that was running, with the file name and line number in brackets. The top at line is where the exception happened. The line below it is the method that called it, and so on down to main. Find the first line that names your own file, such as Main.java, and open that file at that line. Lines that mention java.base or java.util are Java's own code. The cause is almost always in yours.

You can handle an exception instead of letting it stop the program. Put the risky statements in a try block. If an exception of the named kind happens there, Java skips the rest of the try block and runs the catch block. The program then carries on after the catch. The example works this way.
plain.zh:
程序出问题有三种方式。编译错误：javac 拒绝构建程序，什么都不会运行。运行时错误：程序开始运行，随后 Java 在某一行把它停掉，并打印堆栈跟踪。答案错误：程序一直运行到结束，但打印出的内容不对，Java 什么也不说。前两种会带着一条信息，这一课就是教你读这些信息。下面的常见错误里有真实的例子。

读编译错误要从上往下读。第一行有三部分：文件名和行号（例如 Main.java:4）、单词 error，以及问题是什么（例如 cannot find symbol）。下一行重复那一行的代码，并在 Java 卡住的位置下面用插入符 ^ 标出来。有些错误还带详细信息，例如 symbol: variable totl 和 location: class Main，说明 Java 不认识哪个名字，以及它在哪里找过。最后一行统计错误的个数。

有三个习惯很有帮助。先修第一个错误，因为后面的错误常常是它引起的，少一个花括号就可能带来十几条报错。每改一处就重新编译一次。其次，报出的行号是 Java 发现问题的地方，真正的错误可能在上面一行。最后，把信息当作提示，而不是诊断结论。cannot find symbol 只说明 Java 不认识某个名字。

异常没有被处理时，就会出现堆栈跟踪。异常是一种事件，表示程序运行时出了问题，例如除以零，或者使用了数组范围之外的下标。程序会在那一刻停止。堆栈跟踪的第一行写着异常的名字和一条消息。接下来是若干以 at 开头的行，每一行是一个当时正在运行的方法，括号里是文件名和行号。最上面的 at 行是异常发生的地方，它下面一行是调用它的方法，依次往下，一直到 main。找到第一行写着你自己文件名（例如 Main.java）的 at 行，打开那个文件，跳到那一行。提到 java.base 或 java.util 的行是 Java 自己的代码。原因几乎总是在你自己的代码里。

你也可以处理异常，而不是任由它让程序停下来。把有风险的语句放进 try 代码块。如果这里发生了指定种类的异常，Java 就跳过 try 代码块里剩下的部分，转而运行 catch 代码块，之后程序在 catch 后面继续运行。例子就是这样工作的。

meaning.en: A mistake javac finds before the program runs. Nothing runs until it is fixed.
meaning.zh: javac 在程序运行之前发现的错误。不修好就什么都不能运行。

meaning.en: A problem that appears while the program runs and stops it.
meaning.zh: 程序运行过程中出现、并让程序停下来的问题。

meaning.en: An event that signals a problem at run time, such as ArithmeticException.
meaning.zh: 在运行时表示出了问题的事件，例如 ArithmeticException。

meaning.en: The list of methods that were running when an exception happened, newest first, each with a file name and line number.
meaning.zh: 异常发生时正在运行的方法的清单，最新的在最前，每个方法都带文件名和行号。

meaning.en: try holds statements that might throw an exception. catch runs if one of the named kind happens.
meaning.zh: try 里放可能抛出异常的语句；如果发生了指定种类的异常，就运行 catch。

example.output:
start
age is 12
not a whole number
done

en: readAge calls Integer.parseInt, a Java method that turns text such as 12 into the int 12. It throws a NumberFormatException when the text is not a whole number.
main prints start and then enters the try block.
readAge("12") works and gives 12, so age is 12 is printed.
readAge("twelve") throws a NumberFormatException. Java leaves the try block at once, so the line this line is skipped never runs.
The catch (NumberFormatException e) block matches the kind of exception, so it runs and prints not a whole number.

The program carries on after the catch and prints done. Without the try and catch, the exception would stop the program at step 4. Java would print Exception in thread "main" java.lang.NumberFormatException: For input string: "twelve", then some at lines, and done would never appear.
zh: readAge 调用 Integer.parseInt，这是 Java 的一个方法，把 12 这样的文字变成 int 值 12。文字不是整数时，它会抛出 NumberFormatException。
main 先打印 start，然后进入 try 代码块。
readAge("12") 正常工作，得到 12，于是打印 age is 12。
readAge("twelve") 抛出 NumberFormatException。Java 立刻离开 try 代码块，所以 this line is skipped 那一行永远不会运行。
catch (NumberFormatException e) 代码块与这种异常匹配，于是运行并打印 not a whole number。
程序在 catch 之后继续运行，打印 done。如果没有 try 和 catch，异常会在第 4 步就让程序停下来。Java 会打印 Exception in thread "main" java.lang.NumberFormatException: For input string: "twelve"，再跟着几行 at，而 done 永远不会出现。

why.en: javac prints Main.java:3: error: ';' expected, then the line int total = 5 with the caret just after the 5. A statement is missing its semicolon. The line number points at the statement that lacks it. Add the semicolon where the caret is.
why.zh: javac 会打印 Main.java:3: error: ';' expected，接着是 int total = 5 这一行，插入符就在 5 的后面。一条语句漏掉了分号。行号指向缺分号的那条语句。在插入符所在的位置补上分号。

why.en: javac prints four lines: Main.java:4: error: cannot find symbol, then the code line, then symbol: variable totl, then location: class Main. Read them like this. The mistake is on line 4 of Main.java. The unknown name is totl, a variable. Java looked in class Main and did not find it. The variable was declared as total, so this is a typo.
why.zh: javac 会打印四行：Main.java:4: error: cannot find symbol，然后是代码行，接着是 symbol: variable totl，最后是 location: class Main。这样读：错误在 Main.java 的第 4 行；不认识的名字是 totl，一个变量；Java 在 Main 类里找过，没有找到。这个变量声明时叫 total，所以这是拼写错误。

why.en:
This compiles, but when it runs Java prints:
Exception in thread "main" java.lang.ArithmeticException: / by zero
at Main.average(Main.java:3)
at Main.main(Main.java:7)
Read it from the top. The first line says what happened: an integer was divided by zero. The first at line is where: method average, line 3 of Main.java, the line return total / count;. The next at line says who called it: main, at line 7. So the division is on line 3, and the 0 came from the call on line 7. Decide which one to fix. Here the method should check for a zero count.
why.zh:
这段代码能通过编译，但运行时 Java 会打印：
Exception in thread "main" java.lang.ArithmeticException: / by zero
at Main.average(Main.java:3)
at Main.main(Main.java:7)
从最上面读起。第一行说明发生了什么：一个整数被零除。第一条 at 行说明在哪里：average 方法，Main.java 的第 3 行，也就是 return total / count; 这一行。下一条 at 行说明是谁调用的：main，在第 7 行。所以除法在第 3 行，而那个 0 来自第 7 行的调用。要决定修哪一处。这里应该让方法检查 count 是不是零。

q.en: javac prints: Main.java:12: error: cannot find symbol, then symbol: variable cnt, then location: class Main. Which line do you open, and what do you suspect?
q.zh: javac 打印：Main.java:12: error: cannot find symbol，然后是 symbol: variable cnt，再是 location: class Main。你该打开哪一行？你怀疑是什么问题？

a.en: Open line 12 of Main.java. Java does not know a variable called cnt there. Suspect a typo (perhaps the variable is called count), a variable that was never declared, or a variable declared inside other braces, so that it is out of reach on line 12.
a.zh: 打开 Main.java 的第 12 行。Java 在那里不认识叫 cnt 的变量。可以怀疑是拼写错误（也许变量其实叫 count）、变量根本没有声明，或者变量声明在别的花括号里面，所以在第 12 行够不着它。

q.en: A program stops with this output: Exception in thread "main" java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 3 out of bounds for length 3, then at Main.last(Main.java:9), then at Main.main(Main.java:15). Which method failed, on which line, and what does the message tell you?
q.zh: 一个程序停下来时的输出是：Exception in thread "main" java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 3 out of bounds for length 3，然后是 at Main.last(Main.java:9)，再是 at Main.main(Main.java:15)。哪个方法出了问题，在哪一行？这条消息告诉了你什么？

a.en: The method last failed, on line 9 of Main.java. main called it from line 15. The message says that index 3 was used on an array of length 3, whose valid indexes are 0 to 2. Open line 9 and look at the index. It is probably length instead of length - 1, or a loop that uses <= instead of <.
a.zh: 出问题的是 last 方法，在 Main.java 的第 9 行。main 是在第 15 行调用它的。消息说明在长度为 3 的数组上使用了下标 3，而有效下标是 0 到 2。打开第 9 行，看看那个下标。很可能是写成了 length 而不是 length - 1，或者循环里用了 <= 而不是 <。

q.en: Write the try and catch lines that print bad number instead of stopping the program when Integer.parseInt(text) fails.
q.zh: 写出 try 和 catch 的代码：当 Integer.parseInt(text) 失败时，打印 bad number，而不是让程序停下来。

text.en: Go on to the Java course (INFO1113)
text.zh: 继续学习 Java 课程（INFO1113）
